description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven criteria when evaluating a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system, as reported in the paper “A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages.” The vertical axis lists the criteria in descending order of participant selection: “Relevant FCs” (6 participants), “FC Summary” (5), “Relevance Explanation” (3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (3), “Overall Summary” (2), “Filters” (1), and “Veracity Explanation” (1). The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” ranges from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar of distinct color, with the value numerically labeled at the end of each bar. The bars are sorted in descending order by participant count, with “Relevant FCs” being the most selected criterion and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” tied as the least selected. No additional annotations, error bars, or groupings are present; the chart provides a straightforward frequency distribution of participant preferences across evaluation criteria.
